name: kinthread.groups.list
description: List groups visible to the bound account.

name: kinthread.groups.get
description: Read one group, its members and its role matrix.

name: kinthread.members.list
description: List members, including people who have left, with name and role history.

name: kinthread.members.get
description: Read one member, including display-name and avatar history.

name: kinthread.members.lookup
description: Find members by person id, handle or display name. Display-name lookup is NFKC and case folded and returns every match.

name: kinthread.roles.get
description: Read the permission matrix for a group.

name: kinthread.vault.list
description: List vault items with masked field values.

name: kinthread.vault.item.get
description: Read one vault item with masked field values.

name: kinthread.vault.access.list
description: List grants. Expiry is computed from the run clock and is not stored.

name: kinthread.notes.get
description: Read the pinned care note.

name: kinthread.notes.history
description: Read every version of the pinned care note.

name: kinthread.checklist.list
description: List checklist items.

name: kinthread.activity.list
description: List group activity lines.

name: kinthread.members.add
description: Add a bound person to a group. The assistant acts as the account owner.

name: kinthread.members.remove
description: Remove a member and revoke that person's active grants.

name: kinthread.groups.settings.update
description: Update group settings at the observed settings version.

name: kinthread.assistant_label.update
description: Set the label shown on the assistant's activity lines.

name: kinthread.roles.set
description: Change a member's role. A role change can leave a Mail notice pending until the task runner publishes it.

name: kinthread.ownership.transfer
description: Transfer ownership. Only the current owner can do this.

name: kinthread.vault.reveal
description: Return one cleartext field and record the reveal.

name: kinthread.vault.access.grant
description: Grant view, reveal or manage on a vault item.

name: kinthread.vault.access.revoke
description: Revoke a vault grant.

name: kinthread.vault.item.update
description: Edit one vault field at the observed item version.

name: kinthread.notes.update
description: Replace the pinned care note at the observed note version.

name: kinthread.checklist.add
description: Add a checklist item.

name: kinthread.checklist.complete
description: Mark a checklist item done.

name: kinthread.checklist.reopen
description: Reopen a done checklist item.

name: kinthread.checklist.remove
description: Remove a checklist item.
